items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I saw all this crowd stopping by... near the back end of the Apollo Theater... 'them three old B's... Bob Dorsey, Ben Webster and --- I said, who? He said, the three B's up there. I said, oh, Lord, said, I ain't going to get in this.'

ctx.x: But that's the way Bob was. Bob Carroll, Ben Webster and Bob Dorsey --
